instance_share_is_the_illusion.name: instance_share_is_the_illusion

predictions.depends_on: Stage-1 Gate-0 in-context cells ORC/TYP/DEC/EMP at k=3, token-matched to ~430 tokens, base agent on valid_seen+valid_unseen+H at 3 seeds paired on (game,seed); Measurement A k=3 gain as the external reference for the 0.7 criterion.
predictions.falsifier: TYP >= ORC, or DEC exceeding EMP by more than 4 net, or type share below 0.7 x the Measurement A k=3 gain.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: ORC is the evaluated game's own walkthrough, an information superset of any same-type walkthrough, so ORC > TYP can fail only if the agent cannot execute its own plan, a mechanism the proposal never names, and Gate 0 converts that outcome into 'instance half untestable' rather than a falsification; the DEC~EMP clause's +/-4 margin equals the stated +/-4 single-contrast half-width.
predictions.fix: Promote the scene-matched-but-other-task walkthrough cell from ablation to the confirmatory Stage-1 set as the ORC comparator, set the format-share equivalence margin above the measured CI, and pre-register Gate-0 failure as a falsification of P1 rather than as untestability.

predictions.depends_on: memory-free OPD-ORC vs memory-free OPD-TYP on the pooled 698 games at 3 seeds, with both the acceptance band and the falsifier scaled to the Stage-1 instance share whose gate floor is 8 net, and training-seed variance from the two-seed arms added to the CI.
predictions.falsifier: difference >= 0.5 x instance share (>= 4 net at the gate floor), i.e. instance-bound scene priors do distil.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: At the Gate-0 floor the falsifier is 4 net and the acceptance band 2 net while the proposal's own pooled half-width for a single contrast is +/-4 before the training-seed variance it says it will add, so both the pass and the fail region lie inside the stated noise (the proposal concedes 0.5 x instance share is only 'at' the MDE).
predictions.fix: Raise the Gate-0 instance-share threshold (e.g. >= 16 net) or add seeds/games until the seed-inclusive half-width is below 0.25 x the measured instance share, so the acceptance band and the falsifier are separated by more than the CI.

predictions.depends_on: memory-free OPD-TYP, CD-TYP, OPD-DEC and OPD-EMP students on the three evaluation sets at 2 seeds; the Gate-0 type share (>= 15 net) sets both the 50 % retention bar and the 0.25 x equivalence margin.
predictions.falsifier: OPD-DEC ~ OPD-TYP (retained gain is context-induced format, not procedure), or the TYP students retaining less than 50 % of the type share.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The token-matched DEC teacher is a real arm that could plausibly transfer as much as TYP, and the stated falsifier is a >= 7.5-net move at the gate floor, above the pooled 2-seed noise; only the secondary DEC~EMP equivalence margin (3.75 net) sits under the ladder's own CI.

predictions.depends_on: every trained student evaluated with the ORC block versus memory-free, compared to the base agent's Stage-1 instance share, and compared across OPD/CD/SFT as a difference of differences with a stated +/-6 net half-width.
predictions.falsifier: an ORC-gap outside [0.7, 1.3] x the base instance share for any student, or an objective-to-objective difference beyond the margin.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: At the Gate-0 floor the required window is 5.6-10.4 net, a +/-2.4-net band, and the between-objective clause is a difference of differences whose own stated half-width is +/-6 net, so no observed value can be placed outside the window with confidence; note also that the student gap is ORC minus empty while the base instance share is ORC minus TYP, so the two estimands are not the same contrast.
predictions.fix: Power the ORC-gap contrasts to a half-width below 0.3 x the measured instance share (more seeds/games, or a higher instance-share gate), pre-register one objective pair rather than all three, and define the student gap against the same TYP reference used for the base instance share.

predictions.depends_on: per-type analysis over six types at n = 40-90 games per type per split, plus the second partition with cool-then-place removed from both B and T and the re-insertion check that puts the type back into B.
predictions.falsifier: memory-free gain above 3 net on the procedure-held-out type, or retained gain and deployment gap not concentrating on the named types.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Per-type cells are explicitly exploratory below the proposal's own 150-game rule, so a 3-net threshold sits far inside the per-type CI; in addition the held-out-type null asks the student to lack a procedure the partition removed from both B and T, and the 'once that type is put back in B' clause merely re-runs the Stage-1 TYP cell on the standard partition.
predictions.fix: Raise per-type paired counts above the stated 150-game rule or restrict the claim to two pre-registered types, and turn the held-out-type null into an equivalence with a margin above the measured per-type CI plus a P-CD0 general-capability control scored on that same type.

shared_terms: P1-P2: the Stage-1 instance share (ORC - TYP) is both an estimand of P1 and the scale of P2's acceptance band and falsifier, so a barely-passing gate automatically shrinks P2's falsifier toward the noise.
P2-P4: both are expressed as fractions of the same base instance share, and P4's target window is the very quantity P2's 0.25/0.5 bounds are fractions of.
P1-P3: the type share (TYP - EMP) fixes P1's 0.7 x Measurement-A criterion, P3's 50 % retention bar and P3's 0.25 x equivalence margin simultaneously.
P1-P4: the EMP cell is the shared baseline term inside the Stage-1 shares and inside every student's memory-free accuracy, so a shift in EMP moves both predictions together.
instance_share_is_the_illusion.headline: P2

student_side_abundance.name: student_side_abundance

predictions.depends_on: student-side QLoRA ladder k_train in {0,1,3,7} on T, memory-free evaluation pooled over valid_seen+valid_unseen+H, 3 seeds for the confirmatory k=1 vs k=7 pair, threshold scaled to the Gate-0 k_train=0 gain (>= 12 net).
predictions.falsifier: k=7 memory-free accuracy at or above k=1 memory-free accuracy.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The sign flip is a directional outcome the design can genuinely produce, the length confound is separately controlled by the DEC arms, and 0.4 x 12 = ~5 net sits just above the stated ~4-net pooled MDE, though the four-dose monotonicity clause is only a 2-seed trend by the proposal's own admission.

predictions.depends_on: DEC-7 arm (other-type items token-matched to ~1,010 block tokens) versus the k_train=0 student, memory-free, on the exploratory ladder at 2 seeds; equivalence margin 0.25 x Gate-0 gain (~3 net).
predictions.falsifier: DEC-7 dropping as much as k=7, i.e. a long-prefix effect rather than information abundance.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: DEC-7 sits in the exploratory ladder that the proposal itself says resolves only trends (+/-8 net at 274 x 2 per split), so a ~3-net equivalence margin and the distinction between a 0-net and a ~5-net drop both fall inside its CI.
predictions.fix: Promote DEC-7 (and DEC-3) into the confirmatory set at 3 seeds pooled over all three evaluation sets, so the half-width is below the 0.25 x Gate-0-gain margin.

predictions.depends_on: reliance index = matched k=3 minus absent, and harm index = absent minus mismatched, computed per student across the k_train ladder.
predictions.falsifier: reliance and/or mismatched-memory harm flat or decreasing in k_train.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: Both indices contain the memory-free (absent) accuracy with a negative sign, so P1's predicted decline in that same measured term mechanically raises both unless the matched and mismatched accuracies fall in lockstep with it, a case the proposal neither predicts nor controls.
predictions.fix: Pre-register the matched-block and mismatched-block accuracies as separate estimands (or use a ratio-form reliance index) so P3 can fail while P1 holds.

predictions.depends_on: teacher-side on-policy reverse-KL ladder k_t in {1,3,7} plus P-CD0, with the student prompt carrying no memory block at train or test, evaluated at 2 seeds, acceptance stated as non-decreasing 'within CI'.
predictions.falsifier: a decline in memory-free accuracy across the teacher-side ladder.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: No teacher-side arm puts a block in the student's prompt, so the train/test prompt mismatch that drives the student-side decline is removed by construction and a decline could only arise from a teacher-student distribution gap the proposal never names or measures; the 'within CI' acceptance rule additionally lets any 2-seed null confirm non-decrease, so the crossing of the two curves is largely built in.
predictions.fix: Add a teacher-side arm whose student prompt also carries a token-matched block (or a length-matched empty-content prefix) to separate prompt mismatch from information, and pre-register a decline magnitude above the ladder CI as the falsifier instead of 'within CI'.

predictions.depends_on: per-type memory-free deficit relative to the k_train=0 student versus base-model delta-NLL(k) per type, Spearman over 6 types x 3 doses, decoy delta-NLL, and the self-rollout repeat.
predictions.falsifier: Spearman below 0.6, non-zero decoy delta-NLL, or an undiminished self-rollout effect.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: Both variables rise with the dose k by construction (more context lowers action-token NLL; P1 predicts the deficit grows with k), so pooling 18 type-dose points makes a positive rank correlation follow from the shared dose factor rather than from any type-level correspondence, and decoy delta-NLL ~ 0 restates how the decoy pool was built (other-type items chosen to be irrelevant).
predictions.fix: Compute the correlation within each dose across the six types (or partial out the dose main effect) and pre-register that within-dose statistic, with per-type counts above the stated 150-game rule.

predictions.depends_on: RATE-3 (k=3 applied to a random 50 % of training examples) versus the k=0 and k=3 students on memory-free accuracy and on reliance, 2-seed exploratory ladder.
predictions.falsifier: RATE-3 landing outside the k=0 to k=3 interval on either measure.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: RATE-3 is a 50/50 mixture of the two endpoint training distributions so an interior value is expected by construction, and the whole k=0-to-k=3 interval is only a few net points, well inside the +/-8-net 2-seed ladder CI.
predictions.fix: Run RATE-3 and both endpoints at 3 seeds pooled over the three sets and pre-register a non-inferiority margin smaller than the measured k=0 minus k=3 gap.

shared_terms: P1-P3: memory-free (absent) accuracy is P1's estimand and a negative term in both of P3's indices, so P1's decline determines P3 unless matched accuracy moves with it.
P1-P5: P5's per-type deficit is the per-type decomposition of P1's pooled ladder difference, and both are indexed by the same dose k, which also drives delta-NLL.
P1-P6: RATE-3 is scored against the same k=0 and k=3 memory-free cells that anchor the P1 ladder.
P1-P2: P1's required deficit and P2's equivalence margin are both fractions of the same Gate-0 k_train=0 gain, so a barely-passing gate shrinks them together.
student_side_abundance.headline: P4

memory_carried_traits_need_tokens.name: memory_carried_traits_need_tokens

predictions.depends_on: PC teacher (QLoRA rank 32 on the rewritten bank, rate-matched to MC) versus PC-0 (QLoRA on the unrewritten bank), both under SFT-clean with the T1 inventory action and its observation removed; trait rate at the first action, ~1,400 decision points per arm.
predictions.falsifier: PC/SFT-clean lifting the T1 trait rate by less than 10 pp over PC-0/SFT-clean.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The parameter-carried subliminal channel can genuinely fail on this backbone and SFT-clean deletes the very first-action tokens the trait rate is scored on, so the sanitised data actively models a non-inventory first action; 10 pp is well above the stated ~2.5 pp half-width, although a failure is routed into declaring the memory-carried null uninterpretable rather than counting against the programme.

predictions.depends_on: PC/OPD-masked versus PC/SFT-clean, with the stated falsifier resting instead on PC/OPD-masked versus PC-0/OPD-masked, two training seeds each and seed variance added to the CI; conditional on P1 holding.
predictions.falsifier: PC/OPD-masked within 5 pp of PC-0/OPD-masked while P1 holds.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The falsifier is a 5 pp equivalence at the design's own stated ~5 pp MDE for exactly that test, with the four-arm training-seed variance then added on top, so the falsifying band lies inside the noise; the prediction's own clause (OPD-masked >= SFT-clean) carries no margin at all and is confirmed by any tie.
predictions.fix: Add decision points (3 seeds, or a trait with several rule-identified decision points per episode) until the seed-inclusive half-width is <= 2 pp, and give the >= comparison an explicit non-inferiority margin.

predictions.depends_on: MC teacher (base weights conditioned on k=3 items from the fully rewritten bank B_T) versus MC-0, under SFT-clean (trait step removed) and OPD-masked (KL zeroed on the trait span), students memory-free with an empty block; ceiling clause scored against the MC teacher's own trait rate.
predictions.falsifier: either sanitised or masked MC arm exceeding MC-0 by >= 10 pp.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: For T1 the trait is expressed at exactly one action, scored at exactly that action, and deleted or loss-masked at exactly that action, while the MC teacher differs from the student's base weights only through a context the student's data never contains and inventory-first leaves the world state unchanged, so no channel the proposal names can carry the trait into the memory-free student.
predictions.fix: Score the trait at a second, unmasked decision point, or make the dynamics-bearing T2 trait the central test with full MC-0 and unmasked controls, so a context-carried trait has a route the mask does not delete.

predictions.depends_on: memory-free trait rate of the MC/OPD-full student versus the base agent with B_T at k in {3} - which is exactly the MC teacher's own condition - on identical (game, seed) sets.
predictions.falsifier: the distilled student's memory-free trait rate at or below the in-context rate.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: B_T is entirely rewritten so every retrieved item carries the trait and the retrieval gating the prediction relies on is largely absent, making a student-at-or-below-teacher outcome very reachable - P3's own '>= 0.7 x teacher rate' clause explicitly anticipates undershoot - though the strict inequality is stated without a margin, so near-ties will be indeterminate at the ~2.5 pp half-width.

predictions.depends_on: projecting the PC minus PC-0 LoRA delta (or the mean activation difference at the decision token) out of the student update during OPD-masked and SFT-clean, for both PC and MC teachers.
predictions.falsifier: the projection cutting PC transfer by less than 50 %, or changing the MC arms at all.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The MC clause is scored on a transfer P3 predicts to be zero, so the floor fixes its sign and there is nothing for the projection to reduce, while the PC clause's 50 % cut of a >= 10 pp effect is ~5 pp, exactly the stated equivalence MDE before the added seed variance.
predictions.fix: Make the MC clause conditional on an observed non-zero MC transfer, and power the projection arms (3 seeds, more decision points) until a 5 pp change is resolvable.

predictions.depends_on: the T2 arm list, which contains only MC and PC x {SFT-clean, OPD-masked}; the P1 and P3 contrasts require PC-0, MC-0 and the unmasked full objectives, none of which are run for T2, at ~0.8 usable decision points per episode.
predictions.falsifier: T2 failing to reproduce the P1-P3 sign pattern, or its magnitude not being smaller.
predictions.label: entailed
predictions.reason: The neutral-teacher controls (MC-0, PC-0) and the unmasked ceilings are absent from the T2 arms, so the contrasts that define the P1-P3 sign pattern cannot be formed for T2 at all, and 'smaller magnitude' is asserted without any stated margin.
predictions.fix: Add the four T2 controls (MC-0 and PC-0 x SFT-clean, OPD-masked) and the two T2 full-objective ceilings, and pre-register the magnitude comparison as a ratio with a margin above the T2 CI.

shared_terms: P3-P4: the MC teacher's trait rate (base agent with B_T at k=3) is both the denominator of P3's 0.7 x ceiling clause and P4's comparator, so the two predictions score the same ratio from opposite sides.
P1-P2: PC/SFT-clean is P1's target and P2's comparator, so P2's outcome is largely fixed by P1's margin once PC/OPD-masked lands near PC-0.
P3-P5: P5's MC clause is scored on exactly the MC transfer P3 predicts to be null, so P3 determines it.
P1-P6 and P3-P6: P6 is defined as the sign pattern of P1-P3 but is measured on an arm set that omits their comparators.
memory_carried_traits_need_tokens.headline: P3

retrieved_memory_privilege_is_scene_boun.name: retrieved_memory_privilege_is_scene_bound

predictions.depends_on: S_match vs S_proc trained on T under MATCH and PROC contexts, evaluated memory-free on valid_unseen; the Experiment-1 audit that no T or H task shares (scene, object, receptacle) with the B item retrieved as its exemplar; G0 = MATCH-EMPTY at Gate 0.
predictions.falsifier: R = S_match - S_proc > 0.25 G0 (about +8 net) on valid_unseen.
predictions.label: entailed
predictions.reason: The audit strips scene/object/receptacle overlap between every training target and its retrieved MATCH exemplar, and valid_unseen shares no scenes with B either, so the item-specific binding channel that is the only route to a large R is deleted before any student is trained.
predictions.fix: Add a MATCH+ arm whose retrieved exemplars deliberately share (scene, object, receptacle) with the target task, so binding transfer has a route to appear in R.

predictions.depends_on: The same R contrast computed separately on valid_seen and valid_unseen from S_match and S_proc; splits are unpaired with each other; +-6.5 net per split at 274 games x 3 seeds.
predictions.falsifier: R_seen - R_unseen < 0.15 G0 (about 4.8 net), i.e. equal within margin.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: A difference of two arm differences across two unpaired splits carries roughly +-13 net at the stated cell sizes, so the 4.8-net threshold sits deep inside the noise, and R is already pushed toward zero by the P1 audit.
predictions.fix: Make the seen-vs-unseen difference-in-differences the primary contrast and power it to an MDE below 0.15 G0 (far more games/seeds, or a within-split matched-scene manipulation that is paired).

predictions.depends_on: Per-type U = teacher_MATCH - S_match and Gate-0 s_type = (PROC-EMPTY)/(MATCH-EMPTY); rank correlation permuted over the ~5 remaining task types and seeds.
predictions.falsifier: U flat across types, or largest on the procedure-bound (high s_type) types.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: With about five ranked types and per-type cells of 40-60 games the per-type CI on U swamps the between-type spread, a permutation over five items floors at p~0.008 only for a perfect ordering, and U and 1-s_type share the per-type teacher MATCH term so any correlation is partly mechanical.
predictions.fix: Increase the number of ranked units (sub-type strata or a second environment), pre-register an MDE for the rank statistic, and define U so it does not share MATCH with s_type.

predictions.depends_on: Per-type retained fraction = (S_match - base)/(MATCH - EMPTY) against per-type s_type = (PROC-EMPTY)/(MATCH-EMPTY), with types binned at s_type >= 0.7 and <= 0.3 from Gate 0.
predictions.falsifier: Retained fraction uniform across types.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Retained fraction and s_type share the denominator MATCH-EMPTY, so a type with a small in-context gain inflates both, and the per-type ratio of two small noisy quantities has CIs far wider than the gap between the 0.6 threshold and uniformity, with no guarantee that any type populates the >=0.7 or <=0.3 bins.
predictions.fix: Require both bins to be populated with Gate-0 CIs excluding 0.7/0.3, report the retained fraction only for types whose MATCH-EMPTY CI excludes zero, and state the MDE for a between-type difference in retained fraction.

predictions.depends_on: F = S_decoy - S_empty and O = S_empty - base, both memory-free, with equivalence margins pre-registered as fractions of G0.
predictions.falsifier: None stated: a significantly negative F is absorbed by recomputing every later margin after subtracting it, and no outcome for O is named as refuting.
predictions.label: entailed
predictions.reason: Both branches of the F clause are accommodated by design (F near zero confirms it, F negative becomes a nuisance correction), so no result of the long-prefix test can come out against the hypothesis.
predictions.fix: State a refuting magnitude for F (e.g. |F| >= 0.25 G0 breaks the decomposition), fix the subtraction rule before unblinding, and name O <= 0 as a falsifier of the self-training term.

predictions.depends_on: pick_two_obj_and_place removed from B and T entirely; all students plus base on the held-out type under absent and matched-memory prompts; about 36 held-out validation games plus held-out train tasks.
predictions.falsifier: Some student beats base on the held-out type, or gains more from matched memory there than base does.
predictions.label: entailed
predictions.reason: Removing the type from both B and T means no arm was trained on it and the retriever has no same-type item to deliver, so the prediction re-describes the pool filter rather than testing type-boundness, and the near-floor 36-game cell could not support the equivalence claim in any case.
predictions.fix: Keep a held-out-type slice in B as retrievable-only (never trained) so matched memory is deliverable, add one arm trained on that type as a positive control, and power the held-out cell.

predictions.depends_on: The full design replicated on own_rollouts_train with a smaller G0; margins pre-registered as fractions of that pool's G0; the same +-6.5 net per-split measurement floor.
predictions.falsifier: The reference-attributable part R becomes the majority on the self-rollout pool.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Majority has no defined denominator, and a smaller G0 shrinks every fraction-of-G0 margin below the fixed +-6.5 net measurement floor, so neither the pattern nor its falsifier can be resolved on that pool.
predictions.fix: Define majority explicitly (e.g. R > 0.5(R+C+F)) with a stated MDE, and impose a Gate-0 floor on the self-rollout G0 (e.g. >= 20 net) below which the replication is declared untestable.

shared_terms: P1-P5: R + C + F = S_match - S_empty identically, so fixing C >= 0.5 G0 and F within margin of zero determines R once the retained gain is measured.
P1-P2: P2 is the same R contrast re-split by scene familiarity, so the audit that drives R toward zero in P1 also bounds P2's difference.
P3-P4: U = teacher_MATCH - S_match and s_type = (PROC-EMPTY)/(MATCH-EMPTY) share the per-type teacher MATCH score, and P4's retained fraction shares the denominator MATCH-EMPTY with s_type.
P1-P4: retained fraction = (S_match - base)/(MATCH - EMPTY) and R both contain S_match, so a low-retention student simultaneously shrinks R and the retained fraction.
retrieved_memory_privilege_is_scene_boun.headline: P1

harm_spillover_is_substrate_bound.name: harm_spillover_is_substrate_bound

predictions.depends_on: D and Sp on poisoned versus sibling types for the in-context k=3 arm and S_sft(p), rho = Sp/D, evaluated at the p where the two substrates' direct harm match; sibling cell about 480 paired episodes (+-7 net), poisoned about 870 (+-5).
predictions.falsifier: rho_sft <= rho_context + margin.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: With D gated at only about 10 net points, rho values of 0.1 versus 0.3 are sibling harms of 1 versus 3 net points against a +-7 sibling CI, so the claimed doubling is roughly an order of magnitude inside the stated noise, and no p on the {0,0.1,0.3,0.5} grid is guaranteed to match D across substrates.
predictions.fix: Power the sibling cell to an MDE of 1-2 net points (or raise D with a stronger poison or higher p until 2x rho is several CI widths) and pre-register the interpolation used to match D across substrates.

predictions.depends_on: Cross-type retrieval rate r_x from the logs and per-retrieved-item harm estimated on the poisoned types, versus measured sibling harm in the frozen in-context arm.
predictions.falsifier: Sp_context exceeds r_x x (direct harm per retrieved poisoned item).
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: For a frozen model the prompt is the only channel from bank to behaviour, so sibling harm without a cross-retrieved poisoned item is excluded by construction, and the falsifier survives only through per-item harm being larger on sibling types than on the poisoned types where it is estimated, a mechanism the design neither names nor measures.
predictions.fix: Estimate per-retrieved-item harm separately on sibling-type episodes (an arm that forces a poisoned item into sibling prompts) so the inequality compares two independently measured terms rather than one term against itself.

predictions.depends_on: D_context(p) over the p grid and D_sft(p) at p in {0,0.1,0.3,0.5}, seeds as replicates, poisoned-type CI about +-5 net, Gate-0 floor D_context(0.5) >= 10.
predictions.falsifier: Both substrates linear, or SFT harm super-linear at low p.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Under a 10-net-point harm ceiling every quantity in the prediction is a 1-4 net point contrast against +-5 (D_context(0.1) of 1-3.5, a 1.5x ratio between D_sft(0.5) and D_sft(0.3)), and the clause that D_sft(0.1) is within noise of zero is satisfied by low power alone.
predictions.fix: Score dose shape on a continuous per-episode measure (entry-step rate or wrong-action rate) instead of net success points, and power the p grid to an MDE of about 2 net at p=0.1.

predictions.depends_on: omega = 1 - D(clean memory)/D(absent) for trained students, a ratio of two poisoned-type contrasts each about +-5 net on a base near 10, bootstrapped over games.
predictions.falsifier: omega >= 0.9.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: A ratio whose numerator and denominator each carry +-5 on a 10-point base has a bootstrap CI wide enough to cover both 0.7 and 0.9, so the compliance-trap alternative cannot be separated from the prediction.
predictions.fix: State the MDE for omega and reach it (direct harm of about 25 net, or several times the episode count), and report D(clean) and D(absent) with their own CIs rather than only the ratio.

predictions.depends_on: Teacher compliance rate c(p) logged on the OPSD teacher pass, D_sft(p) and D_opsd(p) at p in {0.1, 0.5}.
predictions.falsifier: D_opsd >= D_sft, or the discount not tracking the measured c(p).
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: At p=0.1 the test is vacuous because P3 already predicts D_sft(0.1) is zero within noise, and at p=0.5 a predicted D_opsd of about c x 10 cannot be separated from D_sft of about 10 when both carry +-5.
predictions.fix: Drop p=0.1, state the margin for the product test in net points, and power D_sft(0.5) to at least about 25 net so a compliance discount of 0.5 sits several CIs from unity.

predictions.depends_on: Entry step and recovery fraction per substrate on harmed episodes only, with the manufactured V1 (appliance step replaced) and V2 (place reordered) poisons whose divergence sits at a fixed position in each type's procedure.
predictions.falsifier: Internalized harm recovers at least as often as in-context harm.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: V1 and V2 put the divergence at a single fixed step of each type's procedure, so the KS coincidence of in-context entry steps with the retrieved item's divergence step is fixed by how the poison was built and has essentially one degree of freedom; only the recovery clause is contingent, and it rests on the few dozen harmed episodes per substrate that a 10-net-point harm yields.
predictions.fix: Add a poison variant whose divergence step varies across items so the KS test can fail, and pre-register a powered MDE for the recovery-fraction halving on the harmed subsample.

predictions.depends_on: pick_and_place and look_in_light control types (about 58 clean games per split plus H) across every arm, with no stated equivalence margin.
predictions.falsifier: Any arm moves a control type beyond margin.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The margin is never stated and the control cells are the smallest in the design, so no arm can be shown equivalent on the controls at the achievable precision and the reassignment-to-forgetting rule can never be triggered reliably.
predictions.fix: Pre-register an equivalence margin in net points for the control types, power those cells to it, and state in advance how a control-type change is subtracted from D and Sp.

shared_terms: P1-P4: rho and omega both take the trained student's direct harm D(absent) as their base, so a mis-estimated D moves the spillover ratio and the override fraction together.
P3-P5: D_opsd(p) = c(p) x D_sft(p) contains D_sft(p), so P3's prediction that D_sft(0.1) is zero within noise turns P5's p=0.1 comparison into an identity between two zeros.
P1-P2: Sp_context is the numerator of rho_context in P1 and the estimand of P2, so P2's retrieval accounting bounds rho_context near zero and mechanically favours P1's ordering.
P3-P6: entry step and recovery are scored only on harmed episodes, whose count is set by D(p), so the P3 dose curve determines the sample available to P6.

style_outruns_content.name: style_outruns_content

predictions.depends_on: S_sft on marked T; M1 (fixed five-token phrase on every thought) and M2 (leading look) planted on every marked-type item of B and T; gamma_marker on unmarked and held-out types with the k=0 baseline subtracted; gamma_content = G(held-out)/G(marked) with pick_two removed from B and T.
predictions.falsifier: Either marker type-confined (gamma_marker <= 0.4), or content reaching the held-out type (gamma_content >= 0.5).
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: The content half re-describes the pool filter (pick_two is removed from B and T, so its content gain can only be nonzero through compositional transfer no arm supplies), and a fixed phrase prefixed to every thought of every marked item is the low-complexity unconditional habit for a LoRA to learn, so type-confinement requires a type-conditioning pressure the design never applies.
predictions.fix: Plant the marker on only part of the marked-type items, or use a different phrase per type so type-conditioning is learnable, and keep a held-out-type slice in T as a positive control that lets gamma_content exceed 0.5.

predictions.depends_on: S_opsd reverse-KL on the student's own memory-free rollouts scored by the marked-memory teacher; teacher memory-conditioned adoption from Gate 0 (>= 0.5); per-episode marker rates at about +-3 pp.
predictions.falsifier: S_opsd marker adoption within margin of the k=0 baseline while it still shows a content gain.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: Both outcomes are mechanically reachable (on-policy reverse-KL can transmit or filter a surface habit) and the 20-plus point gap between 0.5 x teacher adoption and the k=0 baseline is far outside the +-3 pp marker CI.
predictions.fix: Pre-register the content-gain threshold that makes the conjunctive falsifier binding, so an S_opsd arm that simply fails to learn cannot dodge it.

predictions.depends_on: S_sanit = SFT on the marked-memory teacher's trajectories over T with the phrase and the leading look removed; A_M1 scored as the fraction of thoughts starting with that exact phrase, A_M2 as P(first action = look) minus the k=0 baseline.
predictions.falsifier: S_sanit adoption >= 0.3 x S_sft adoption.
predictions.label: entailed
predictions.reason: The sanitizer deletes exactly the tokens the outcome is scored on, and an arbitrary fixed five-token string has a near-zero natural rate, so the trajectory-dynamics channel has no way to express itself in this metric whatever its true strength.
predictions.fix: Score a channel the sanitizer does not delete (paraphrase-level or semantic adoption, thought-length or entropy signature, or a marker with a measurable natural base rate) so the 2604.15559 account has a reachable positive outcome.

predictions.depends_on: One continuation epoch on clean marker-free own-rollout items of the unmarked types only, checkpoints at 0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0 epoch, A_M1, A_M2 and G re-measured on marked types.
predictions.falsifier: Either marker outlives the content, or both decay together.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: The continuation set is direct negative evidence against both markers (clean thoughts, no leading look) but carries no evidence at all about marked-type procedures, so faster marker decay follows from the update rule rather than from any style/content distinction, and 0.25 epoch is also the shortest half-life the checkpoint schedule can resolve.
predictions.fix: Add a continuation arm containing clean marked-type items so both channels face the same contradiction (or a neutral continuation that contradicts neither), and add checkpoints below 0.25 epoch.

predictions.depends_on: S_sft at r in {8, 32, 128} with adoption margins pre-registered as a fraction of the Gate-0 adoption rate; no seed replication stated for the rank arms (two seeds are specified only for the durability students).
predictions.falsifier: r=32 exceeds both r=8 and r=128 by more than the margin (an inverted-U).
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The quoted +-3 pp is evaluation noise only and each rank arm has a single LoRA seed, so an apparent inverted-U cannot be separated from training-seed variation, which the design bounds nowhere for these arms.
predictions.fix: Run at least three LoRA seeds per rank and pre-register the inverted-U margin in adoption points relative to the measured seed spread.

predictions.depends_on: The frozen model with in-context k=3 from the marked bank; marker adoption on unmarked types versus the k=0 baseline, conditioned on cross-retrieval flags from the logs.
predictions.falsifier: In-context marker adoption on unmarked types departs from the k=0 baseline with no marked item retrieved.
predictions.label: entailed
predictions.reason: For an untrained model the prompt is the only route by which a planted phrase or leading look can appear, so conditioning on no cross-retrieval leaves nothing but sampling noise, and the proposal itself declines to count the result as a confirmation.
predictions.fix: Test induction rather than presence, e.g. in-context items marked on a different task type, so cross-type marker generalization has a route into the metric.

predictions.depends_on: Trained students evaluated under the mismatched prompt condition (token-matched other-type items) against their memory-free adoption; adoption CI about +-3 pp.
predictions.falsifier: Mismatched context suppresses adoption to the k=0 baseline.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: The mismatched condition is only token-matched other-type items and is never required to be marker-free or marker-contradicting, so items drawn from the marked bank carry M1/M2 and reinforce the habit, leaving suppression reachable only through an interference mechanism the design does not construct.
predictions.fix: Draw the mismatched items from an explicitly marker-free or counter-marked bank (different fixed phrase, no leading look) and report the injected items' marker rate in every prompt condition.

shared_terms: P1-P2: gamma_marker for S_sft and for S_opsd share A_M on marked types as the denominator, so low marked-type adoption inflates both generalization ratios.
P1-P3: S_sanit adoption is normalized by S_sft adoption, the same quantity that is P1's denominator, so confirming P1 raises the bar P3 must clear.
P3-P4: both are scored on emission of the same fixed phrase, so the sanitizer's deletion and the clean continuation's suppression act on the same measured term.
P1-P6: gamma_marker's numerator is marker adoption on unmarked types, the same quantity P6 predicts equals the k=0 baseline in context, and both subtract the same baseline rate.
